description: Details for one business ShoreGrade lists, by its ShoreGrade page URL (https://shoregrade.ca/b/<slug>/) or its slug. A ShoreGrade score measures a business's website and Google listing out of 100. It does not rate the quality of the work, the service or the reliability of the business.
